target.title: fix(anthropic): sanitize image media_type to prevent HEIC/TIFF 400 errors (#102323)
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #102323. Anthropic only supports four image MIME types: `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/gif`, and `image/webp`. Previously, unsupported types such as `image/heic` (iPhone camera default) and `image/tiff` were passed through verbatim to the Anthropic Messages API, causing the API to reject the entire turn with HTTP 400. The identical image block succeeds on OpenAI and Gemini.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds `sanitizeAnthropicImageMediaType()` which validates the MIME type against Anthropic's four supported types and falls back to `image/png` for anything else. Applied at all four image-block construction sites across two files:

- `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` (2 call sites)
- `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` (2 call sites)

## Evidence

### Proof script

```
=== Anthropic supported types pass through ===
  ✓ image/jpeg → image/jpeg
  ✓ image/png → image/png
  ✓ image/gif → image/gif
  ✓ image/webp → image/webp

=== Unsupported types fall back to image/png ===
  ✓ image/heic → image/png (iPhone default)
  ✓ image/HEIC → image/png (case)
  ✓ image/tiff → image/png
  ✓ image/bmp → image/png
  ✓ image/svg+xml → image/png

=== BEFORE fix ===
  HEIC image → "image/heic" → Anthropic 400 error!

=== AFTER fix ===
  HEIC image → "image/png" → Anthropic accepts ✓
9 passed, 0 failed
```

## Files Changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` | +helper function; apply at 2 call sites |
| `packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.ts` | +helper function; apply at 2 call sites |
